# The Bake Basket

> The Bake Basket (also known as The Bake Basket by Priya) is a fresh-to-order home bakery in Madhavaram, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India, run by founder and baker Priya Shell. It bakes celebration cakes, bento cakes, cupcakes, brownies, cookies, fresh breads, savoury bakes, millet and no-maida healthy bakes, Chennai fusion flavours such as filter-coffee cake, gift hampers, and traditional South Indian steamed foods such as kozhukattai, vattayappam, ela ada, puttu and idiyappam. Every order is baked after it is placed. Most items can be made eggless. Orders are taken on WhatsApp.

## Key facts
- Name: The Bake Basket (by Priya)
- Tagline: Baked to make your day!
- Founder and baker: Priya Shell
- Address: 229, 1F, AP Achalendra Apartment, Madhavaram Red Hills Highways, Madhavaram, Chennai 600060, Tamil Nadu, India
- Open: Monday to Saturday. Closed on Sundays.
- Orders: WhatsApp +91 90430 27981 (https://wa.me/919043027981); email hello@thebakebasket.com
- Lead time: please order cakes 2 days ahead; festival orders and tiered cakes earlier
- Pickup and delivery: by arrangement; North Chennai neighbourhoods are closest (Madhavaram, Moolakadai, Kolathur, Kodungaiyur, Puzhal, Manali, Perambur, Red Hills)
- Prices: confirmed in writing for each order on WhatsApp
- Payment safety: orders and payments only through +91 90430 27981

## Delivery areas
- [Cakes & Bakes in Madhavaram, Chennai | The Bake Basket](https://thebakebasket.com/delivery-areas/madhavaram/): This is home. Our kitchen is on the Madhavaram Red Hills Highway, so for most of Madhavaram your cake is only a few minutes old when it reaches your door.
- [Cakes & Bakes in Moolakadai, Chennai | The Bake Basket](https://thebakebasket.com/delivery-areas/moolakadai/): Moolakadai junction is a short run down the road from our kitchen, which makes it one of the easiest places in Chennai for us to reach with a cake still cold from the fridge.
- [Cakes & Bakes in Kolathur, Chennai | The Bake Basket](https://thebakebasket.com/delivery-areas/kolathur/): Kolathur is full of young families, and that means birthdays. Lots of them. It sits just south-west of us, close enough that a theme cake can come straight from our kitchen to your hall or living room.
- [Cakes & Bakes in Kodungaiyur, Chennai | The Bake Basket](https://thebakebasket.com/delivery-areas/kodungaiyur/): Kodungaiyur is our neighbour to the east, a quick ride across for anything from a single bento cake to a full Deepavali basket.
- [Cakes & Bakes in Puzhal, Chennai | The Bake Basket](https://thebakebasket.com/delivery-areas/puzhal/): Up the road towards Red Hills, Puzhal is one of the closest neighbourhoods on our side of the city. Your order comes straight up the highway from our kitchen.
- [Cakes & Bakes in Red Hills, Chennai | The Bake Basket](https://thebakebasket.com/delivery-areas/red-hills/): Red Hills is at the far end of the very highway our kitchen sits on. It's a straight run up the road, past Puzhal, to your door.
- [Cakes & Bakes in Manali, Chennai | The Bake Basket](https://thebakebasket.com/delivery-areas/manali/): Manali is north-east of our kitchen, home to the industrial belt and to the families who live around it.
- [Cakes & Bakes in Perambur, Chennai | The Bake Basket](https://thebakebasket.com/delivery-areas/perambur/): Perambur is one of North Chennai's oldest neighbourhoods, and its families know exactly what a good plum cake or a proper butter cookie should taste like. We take that seriously.
- [Cakes & Bakes in Villivakkam, Chennai | The Bake Basket](https://thebakebasket.com/delivery-areas/villivakkam/): Villivakkam sits on the western side of our delivery map, between Kolathur and Anna Nagar, and a good fit for birthday cakes and weekend breads.
- [Cakes & Bakes in Anna Nagar, Chennai | The Bake Basket](https://thebakebasket.com/delivery-areas/anna-nagar/): Anna Nagar is a little further from our North Chennai kitchen, but it's a part of the city that loves a well-made cake, and we're glad to bake for it.
- [Cakes & Bakes in Thiruvottiyur, Chennai | The Bake Basket](https://thebakebasket.com/delivery-areas/thiruvottiyur/): Out towards the sea, Thiruvottiyur is home to many families who keep the old festival foods alive, which suits us well.
- [Cakes & Bakes in Ambattur, Chennai | The Bake Basket](https://thebakebasket.com/delivery-areas/ambattur/): Ambattur is the furthest of our regular areas to the west, and a natural fit for office and bulk orders.
